name: How do I choose a contractor for a multi-family renovation project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for a multi-family renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for a multi-family renovation, prioritize experience with similar-scale projects, proven financial stability, and a strong track record of successful completions. Look for contractors who offer comprehensive services, including design coordination, project management, and permit handling. Verify their licensing, insurance, and client references. A reputable contractor should provide transparent communication, detailed proposals, and a clear understanding of your specific goals. Opus Builders specializes in luxury multi-family renovations, focusing on quality craftsmanship and efficient project execution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in multi-family projects, financial stability, and strong references. Verify licensing, insurance, and seek transparent communication and detailed proposals.
